answer: An attacker planning 1,000 fake identities faces a lottery they cannot rig: each epoch, a VRF beacon draws 5% of identities at random and demands a work proof within 2 epochs. Seven jurors verify it. Missing the deadline freezes rewards for 6 epochs; a second miss forfeits 50% of the 120-unit stake. A violet flag marks every missed proof on the public record, and a hollow farm gets exposed fast, because no sonnet of fake logs can substitute for a proof tied to real tasks. 1,000 clones lock 120,000 units; expected forfeits reach about 6,000 units per round.
